newsitem.title: USA: Mitchell Bancorp in share buyback program.
newsitem.headline: Mitchell Bancorp in share buyback program.

text.p: Mitchell Bancorp Inc said on Tuesday it authorized the repurchase of up to five percent of its 979,897 outstanding common shares.
The shares will be bought generally on the open market during a six-month period beginning March 20. The board may decide to extend the program after six months.
The repurchased shares may be used to fund stock benefit programs approved by shareholders in January.
Mitchell shares were trading Tuesday at 15-3/4, up 9/16 from their Monday close.
Mitchell is the holding company for Mitchell Savings Bank Inc, which converted from mutual to stock form in July 1996. It has assets of about $34 million.
